description: Road Traffic Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Donghyun Park, Yong-Shin Kang. The dataset is generated using VISSIM, a microscopic traffic simulation software. The simulated environment accurately reproduces mixed traffic conditions involving both autonomous and conventional vehicles in the autonomous driving demonstration zone of Pangyo, South Korea. Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
